title: Live imaging of mRNA using Pepper RNA-stabilized fluorogenic proteins
protocol: Culture U2OS cells in a T75 cell culture flask with DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, 100 U/ml penicillin and 100 μg/ml streptomycin at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Prewarm culture media, 1xPBS, and TrypLE Express in a 37°C water bath.
Aspirate culture media from the flask, gently rinse cells with 1xPBS, aspirate PBS, then add 2 ml of TrypLE Express to the culture flask.
Incubate under 37°C for 5 to 10 minutes to detach cells from the flask.
Add 8 ml of fresh culture media to the culture flask and pipette up and down gently to ensure all cells are fully detached from the flask.
Transfer resuspended cells from the culture flask to a 15 ml tube, then centrifuge at 300 g for 3 minutes.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cell pellet with fresh culture media by gentle pipetting to make sure cells are fully resuspended.
Count the number of cells using a hemocytometer.
Seed 2 x 10^5 cells in each 35 mm poly-D-lysine-coated imaging dish with 2 ml of culture media, gently shaking the dish to ensure even distribution.
Keep the imaging dish at 37°C with 5% CO2 overnight.
For transfection, prepare a 1.7 ml tube for each imaging dish.
Add 125 μl of Opti-MEM to the tube.
Add 1.4 μg of mRNA reporter plasmids to the tube.
Add an optimal amount of plasmid encoding (mNeonGreen)4-tDeg to the tube.
Add 9.6 μl of FuGENE® HD reagent to the tube.
Mix thoroughly by pipetting up and down.
Incubate at room temperature for 10 to 15 minutes.
Add the mixture drop by drop to the imaging dish with cells.
Keep the imaging dish under 37°C with 5% CO2 overnight.
Prewarm 1xPBS and culture media on the next day.
Aspirate culture media from the imaging dish.
Gently rinse cells with 1xPBS.
Additorial note: The term "additorial" is incorrect and appears to be a typo. It should likely be "aspirate."
Aspirate 1xPBS.
Add 2 ml fresh culture media to cells.
Culture cells under 37°C with 5% CO2 overnight.
Prewarm 1xPBS prior to live-cell imaging.
Prewarm imaging media (phenol red-free DMEM supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum, 100 U/ml penicillin and 100 μg/ml of streptomycin, 1x GlutaMAX™, and 1 mM sodium pyruvate).
Aspirate culture media from the imaging dish.
Gently rinse cells with 1xPBS.
Aspirate 1xPBS.
Add 2 ml of imaging media to the imaging dish.
Move the imaging dish to the microscope in the prewarmed environmental chamber.
Add sufficient immersion oil on a 100×/1.4-NA oil objective.
Use this objective under phase illumination to focus on adhered cells.
Switch from phase to fluorescence acquisition with FITC filter sets.
Determine the proper exposure time by acquiring images with an exposure time between 50 ms to 200 ms.
Set up software to acquire fluorescence images.
